# Channel beam dimensions
width = 70  # mm
height = 40  # mm
length = 450  # mm
wall_thickness = 5  # mm

# Calculate dimensions for the main block (outer dimensions)
main_block_x = length
main_block_y = width
main_block_z = height

# Calculate dimensions for the subtraction block (inner cavity)
# The cavity width is reduced by 2 * wall_thickness (for left and right walls)
cavity_x = length
cavity_y = width - 2 * wall_thickness
cavity_z = height - wall_thickness  # Only subtract from bottom, open on top

# Calculate position for the cavity block
# It needs to be centered in Y direction and positioned at wall_thickness from bottom in Z
cavity_x_pos = 0
cavity_y_pos = wall_thickness
cavity_z_pos = wall_thickness

print(f"Main block dimensions: {main_block_x} x {main_block_y} x {main_block_z}")
print(f"Cavity dimensions: {cavity_x} x {cavity_y} x {cavity_z}")
print(f"Cavity position: ({cavity_x_pos}, {cavity_y_pos}, {cavity_z_pos})")
